messages.subject: Saudi Arabia / GCC Senior Corporate Leadership | Government Relations, ESG and Strategic Partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Raja,

Your work with senior and leadership talent across the Middle East, with a strong Saudi focus and direct engagement with multinational and large regional businesses, makes this a relevant introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans senior government and regulatory relations, ESG and sustainability, external and corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, executive advisory and cross-functional country-facing delivery within a major gold-mining operation.

Across 12+ years, my experience spans multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations. My current responsibilities sit where executive leadership, ministries, regulators, communities, investment priorities and complex industrial operations intersect.

Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority, followed by the UAE. I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Country Leadership, External or Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Chief of Staff and Executive Operations mandates. My strongest fit is with multinational, industrial, manufacturing, infrastructure and other regulated environments requiring strong institutional and stakeholder leadership.

I would welcome consideration for suitable current or upcoming senior mandates. My Gulf-focused executive CV is attached. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

Preferred reply/contact: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
